The "Berner Group" name refers to two separate major European companies. The information below details both to ensure you find the specific one you are looking for.

The
Berner Group
operates as a major European B2B trading specialist and manufacturer offering over 100,000 maintenance, repair, and chemical products tailored for the mobility, construction, and industrial sectors
. Its core business is structured around distinct market-facing product brands rather than reliance on outside manufacturer labels.
Core Product Brands
Berner
: The flagship B2B brand providing C-parts, tools, workshop equipment, and chemical specialties directly to automotive and construction trades.
dokumen.pub
BTI (BTI by Berner)
: A specialized brand focused on trade professionals in the construction, window-mounting, roofing, and fire protection sectors.
dokumen.pub
Caramba
: The primary chemical-specialty division developing and manufacturing high-performance cleaners, surface protection, and maintenance fluids.
Berner Group
KENT
: An automotive aftermarket and industrial chemical brand focused on high-tech repair and refinishing products.
Berner Group
Ambratec
: A complementary chemical and technical product brand for professional cleaning and industrial maintenance.
dokumen.pub
Manufacturer Partnerships & Supply Model
Direct Manufacturing
: The Berner Group acts as its own primary developer and manufacturer for its chemical portfolios via dedicated production hubs (such as Caramba facilities in Germany).
dokumen.pub
B2B Global Sourcing
: Rather than promoting external co-branding partners, Berner operates an integrated supply network, directly qualifying and sourcing technical hardware, hand tools, power tools, and C-parts globally to sell under its proprietary quality standards.
If you are looking for specific item categories or regional availability from the
Berner Group portfolio
, please specify the
trade sector
(automotive, construction, or industrial chemistry) you need details on.
